data.investment_objective: ICICI Prudential Passive Multi-Asset Fund of Funds is a Fund of Funds scheme with the primary objective to generate returns by predominantly investing in passively managed funds launched in India and/or overseas. However, there can be no assurance or guarantee that the investment objective of the Scheme would be achieved.

• Units of mutual fund schemes asstated below = 95%-100% 
A) Domestic Equity ETFs/Index Funds = 25% - 65% 
B) Domestic Debt ETFs/Index Funds = 25% -  65% 
C) ETFs/Index Funds investing in Overseas securities = 10% -  30% 
D) Domestic Gold ETFs = 0% - 15%                                                                                      
• Reverse Repo, Tri-Party Repo, Units of Debt oriented mutual fund schemes = 0%- 5%
data.benchmark: CRISIL Hybrid 50+50- Moderate Index (80% weightage) + S&P Global 1200 Index (15% weightage) + Domestic Gold Price (5% weightage)
